text: The Acting Director, Program Support, Economic Development and Culture and the Acting Director, Business Growth Services, Economic Development and Culture will give a presentation on Supporting a Safe Reopening in the Business and Culture Sectors. The presentation will provide an overview of key initiatives that the Economic Development and Culture Division is undertaking, including the ShowLoveTO campaign.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Received the presentation from the Acting Director, Program Support, Economic Development and Culture and the Acting Director, Business Growth Services, Economic Development and Culture, headed "Economic Development and Culture COVID-19 Response", for information.
